singleMeaning: Framework Single: Planner plus one coding/test/self-review role, possibly multiple turns; no independent Author/Verifier.
policy: Two separate repositories cloned from same immutable scaffold before any model call. Same original SPEC/tools/model/effort/cap; run sequentially on one Windows machine. Freeze grader and product including uncommitted changes before first model. No manual candidate source/test/manifest edits, hidden grader feedback, discarded failed run, product/schema change mid-run or arbitrary model retry. Record legitimate contract/test-repair/warning/finding approvals with receipts. Grade every implementation, including blocked runs. Single external mutation same defaults/5-minute bound, timed separately. Only accept/deliver local benchmark branch after mandatory product evidence and frozen grader pass; warning acknowledgement never bypasses a blocker. No claims from test counts or general superiority from one trial.
